## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or planning decision.

## Validation

List checks run and results. For UI changes include previews; for runtime changes include platform and resource evidence. State what was not tested.

## Review

- [ ] Scope and English documentation are up to date.
- [ ] No secrets or unlicensed assets are included.
- [ ] App changes include a version/changelog update when applicable.
- [ ] Owner approval is required before merge or publication.
